description: This PHP script manages issue tracker editing in the TestLink project, including rendering GUI, handling actions like create, edit, delete, and checking user rights.

classes.name: TLSmarty
classes.description: Smarty template engine class used for rendering templates.

methods.name: renderGui
methods.description: Handles rendering of the GUI based on action, either via template or redirect.

methods.name: initScript
methods.description: Initializes script components including command manager, arguments, and GUI state.

methods.name: init_args
methods.description: Initializes and sanitizes input arguments based on a whitelist.

methods.name: initializeGui
methods.description: Sets up the GUI state, including user rights and linked test projects.

methods.name: checkRights
methods.description: Checks if the current user has rights to manage issue trackers.
